描述_EN: most winged cups were made of lacquer. this oval cup has two flanged handles and is sometimes called a 'winged cup' or an 'ear cup'. it was a common form of dining vessel in the han dynasty (206 bc-ad 220), used to contain either food or wine. a jade version is very rare.
